cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Taste this cheap coffee substitute before I fill my cup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. If you like this, we can save the proper stuff for guests.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not sacrificing breakfast to save you money.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sip. If it's awful, I'll buy you a croissant and keep my cup empty.

confusable: Ordinary cost saving could use both cups immediately; D32 requires B trial before A relies on the substitute, under A permission rules.
comparison: Taste risk and breakfast compensation differ from the other alternative mechanical spray risk and protective clothing.
seedUse: Use D32-b proper coffee and breakfast objection, with S01 approval setting the limited test and remedy.
